## About me

I did my Bachelors and Masters (_specialization in Physical Chemistry_) at **Jadavpur University, Kolkata, India**. I obtained my Ph.D. (**Doctor rerum naturalium**) degree with [PD Dr. Florian A. Bischoff](https://www.chemie.hu-berlin.de/en/forschung-en/theoretical-chemistry/team/ag-bischoff/team/florian-bischoff) in Theoretical Chemistry at **Humboldt-Universität zu Berlin, Berlin, Germany**. ## My interests

My research interest lies in numerical method development for quantum chemistry, chemical bonding and its philosophical aspects. I also love to write and hence you might find my **pedagogic articles/essays** in the <a href="resources/learn.qmd" class="badge rounded-pill bg-info text-dark text-decoration-none">Learn</a> section interesting. I love computers and an ardent user of linux from a very young age.
